newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * NATO and its East European and neutral partners on Wednesday launched a North Atlantic Partnership designed to bring together the Alliance's members and the countries left out of the first wave of NATO enlargement. The partnership includes the 16 NATO members and 28 "partner" countries.
* Romanian President Emil Constantinescu is expected to deliver a speech at the Partnership's session.
* Romania is the big loser after NATO's Madrid summit when the alliance decided to invite only Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic as new members, international media said.
Comments from the world's biggest newspapers also show that the final text on enlargement gives Romania a clear recognition that its place is within the alliance.
* NATO's clear committment to further enlargement is a guarantee for Romania that it would join the alliance as soon as possible, a statement released by the foreign ministry said.
* Emil Constantinescu will attend a summit of East European leaders in Salzburg on Wednesday to discuss regional security, after NATO's Madrid summit.
* Parliament's upper Senate resumed debates on a controversial road tax bill.
